items.name: Talanoa
items.tagline: Email that feels like chat
items.description: Talanoa is your first email messenger. It turns messy email threads into clean, chat-like conversations, removing quotes, signatures and clutter along the way. Turn emails into actionable todos, manage your calendar without leaving your inbox, and use private, on-device AI to search, summarize and write. Connect Gmail, Outlook, iCloud or any IMAP account in one unified inbox. Everything stays on your computer: no cloud sync, no tracking, no one reading your emails.

items.name: Navige
items.tagline: Cut AI agent costs and control runaway spending
items.description: Navige uses Sufficiency Intelligence to cut AI agent costs while work runs. It sends suitable requests to smaller models, caches repeated reads and trims bulky tool results. If unsure, it keeps your chosen model. Set budgets, catch runaway loops and approve sensitive actions. See costs and savings by job, with estimates clearly labelled. Watchtower is free forever. Preview changes before switching controls on.

items.name: Apple HomeView
items.tagline: A new way to stay connected, and manage the home
items.description: Apple HomeView is a smart display with Siri AI, Liquid Retina display, high-fidelity audio, FaceTime, smart home controls, built-in privacy, and more.

items.name: GLM-Legal
items.tagline: Z.ai’s legal AI model for contract review and compliance
items.description: LM-Legal is Z.ai’s legal AI model, built on GLM-5.3-Flash and trained for agentic legal work like contract review, evidence analysis, and compliance research. Z.ai added legal mid-training, then reinforcement learning across tens of thousands of legal task environments. It passes 19.17% of tasks on Harvey’s Legal Agent Benchmark per Vals AI, up from 6.67% for the base model. API access is application-only beta

items.name: OpenMuse
items.tagline: Opensource, self hostable personal assistant for any harness
items.description: OpenMuse is an open-source, self-hostable personal agent with its own browser, terminal, files, and persistent work. Ask for an outcome, watch it work, review actions, and come back to the result. Compatible with any agent harness.

items.name: Daddy Issues
items.tagline: Think ahead. Fight less. A weekly family briefing for dads.
items.description: Daddy Issues uses AI to help dads think ahead before family life turns into last-minute stress. Each week, it connects your kids, calendar, responsibilities and tasks to surface what’s coming up, what you might be missing, and what’s worth handling now. Less reacting, fewer reminders, fewer small fights — and more “I’m already on it.”

items.name: Polylane Impact Analysis
items.tagline: Catch risky pull requests before they break production
items.description: Catch issues before they break production. Polylane reviews every pull request against your live infrastructure: its config, capacity, dependencies and telemetry. For every pull request, you get a an analysis including all the evidence telling you if the pull request is safe to merge against production. Polylane also proposes missing instrumentation on your branch and keeps watching after deployment.

items.name: withHuman
items.tagline: A open-source human approval layer for AI Agents
items.description: withHuman is an approval layer for AI agents. It intercepts your agents’ tool calls before they run. Rules approve or deny routine calls automatically, and risky ones go to the right person on your team. It works across Claude Code, Codex and agents built with LangGraph, Pydantic AI and more, through an open protocol (AAP). One set of rules for every agent your company runs. Open source, with a hosted version. Use code PRODUCTHUNT for 3 months of Scale free - valid till Friday!

items.name: Chatway MCP
items.tagline: Let ChatGPT & Claude answer customer support tickets via MCP
items.description: Chatway is a live chat and customer support platform that lets you bring your own AI agent. Connect ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, or any MCP-compatible assistant to manage customer conversations, reply to messages, search contacts, and access your knowledge base. No coding required. Chatway also includes a built-in AI Support Agent, shared inbox, help center, automation, iOS and Android apps, and integrations with WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook Messenger, and more. Get started for free.

items.name: Kerno 1.0
items.tagline: The AI Runtime Backend QA Engineer
items.description: Kerno v1 is our biggest upgrade yet, a complete AI Backend QA Engineer. It maps your codebase, learns how your app works, and gets sharper with every run. It now tests your whole backend, from full user flows and live security checks to background jobs, queues, MCP servers and AWS serverless. Bugs get caught inside your agent's session before you open a PR, then re-checked on every PR in CI.

items.name: Ubuntu 26.10 (Stonking Stingray)
items.tagline: GNOME 51, Rust coreutils, and a refreshed Linux desktop
items.description: Ubuntu 26.10 "Stonking Stingray" brings GNOME 51, expanded hardware support, and a complete switch to Rust-based coreutils. App Center unifies Snap and Debian package details and adds graphics driver management. An optional Myna preview offers local speech-to-text. A non-LTS release for developers and Linux enthusiasts who want newer software between long-term releases.

items.name: siliXon
items.tagline: Turn a plain English idea into a circuit board you can order
items.description: Describe your device in plain English and siliXon takes it all the way to a routed, manufacturable PCB, built for anyone with an idea, not only engineers. In minutes. Rocky, our design agent, asks what it needs to know, then picks real, purchasable components, places them, draws the schematic and routes the copper. Edit in 2D and 3D, or just ask Rocky. Every board must pass engineering checks before it goes to manufacture, and the design files are yours.

items.name: Nostaliga
items.tagline: Rediscover the days behind your favorite songs
items.description: Nostaliga turns your listening history into a personal timeline. Pick any song and see the day around it: your photos, places, runs, check-ins, shows and posts. Plus On This Day across the years. No account, no tracking; your timeline lives on your device.

items.name: AI Sandboxes by Buddy
items.tagline: Isolated cloud machines for your AI coding agents
items.description: Buddy Sandboxes give AI coding agents their own isolated Linux machines to build, run, test, and fix apps without touching your local setup. Each Sandbox has a persistent disk, root access, Docker, SSH, and a public URL. Create one per task, branch, or PR, then let your agents manage it through MCP, CLI, SDK, or API.

items.name: Backdrop
items.tagline: Build AI coworkers for any workflow, any industry
items.description: Create AI coworkers for any workflow. Give them access to the right tools and context, and let them research, create, coordinate, follow up, and get work done. Connect them to Slack, Asana, Google, Hubspot, Meta, TikTok, and 1500+ more apps.

items.name: Reelbird
items.tagline: Open Source Loom + Screen Studio alternative for Mac
items.description: Reelbird is a free, open-source Mac screen recorder. The share link is on your clipboard when you stop. Later, add auto-zoom, a smooth cursor and captions, then update the same link. Native Swift, no account, your own S3/R2 bucket. Signed and notarized.

items.name: SuperLocalMemory
items.tagline: Agent memory with Laya, Jev + Google Gemma
items.description: The relaunch of SuperLocalMemory, rebuilt from the ground up and backed by four arXiv papers. One local-first memory brain for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, ChatGPT and any MCP or CLI agent. It never bluffs: recall says supported, related or no answer, checked by Laya on your Mac or Jev online. Find pictures and PDFs by describing them, with Google’s EmbeddingGemma 2. Governed, mesh-connected, AGPL-3.0. Built by Qualixar, the AI Reliability Engineering lab behind 10 open-source products.

items.name: Shrine
items.tagline: A home for your agents
items.description: Shrine lives in your Mac's notch. A glance shows how many Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode sessions are working and which one needs you, so there is no dashboard window to keep open. Each push, pull request and research session earns a piece of pixel art for a small room that fills up as you work. Find the joy in your agents work.

items.name: Afterparty
items.tagline: Automated actions for meeting deliverables
items.description: Note takers give you a list. Afterparty does the list. Paste a transcript or connect your note taker, and agents draft every email, message, invite and CRM note in the right app, with context from your tools. Nothing goes out until you approve it.

items.name: Superdraft
items.tagline: Automatically identify opportunities to email your customers
items.description: Good email opportunities slip by when you’re busy running a business. Superdraft spots them and turns them into on-brand drafts with copy, images, and layout. Edit, export HTML, and send through your existing email platform.
